text: Pressure sensor PT-14 on the east pipeline run is throwing spikes; put a box around every valve flange and clamp visible in the housing photo so we can see what shifted. None of that imagery leaves this compound, not even a thumbnail. Don't burn cycles on the premium detector, the everyday model is plenty.

hey, snapped a pic of the aux generator's nameplate down in the engine room, can you pull the serial and ratings off it? please don't give me a sloppy guess on the digits, I can't afford even one wrong character. no hurry at all though, this isn't a drop-everything thing.

Clause 4.2. For each dashcam frame submitted from the district's school bus fleet, the provider shall mark every pedestrian, bicycle and extended stop-arm within the frame by an enclosing rectangle. Detections of lesser fidelity than the provider's most accurate model shall not be deemed acceptable. Such frames shall not be held in any general queue and shall be processed ahead of all non-safety workloads.
Particle counter in Suite 3 posted a screen snapshot. Transcribe the readout lettering and digits without interpreting them, and skip the top-tier engine; a basic read is fine.

Assistant, look at this morning's gangway footage and put a box around every passenger and piece of luggage on the ramp. Don't give me a rough pass, I want the most accurate detection you've got. It isn't time-sensitive, so don't bump anything else for it.

Hi Priya, the webcam over fermenter 3 keeps catching odd shapes floating in the krausen. Rather than a yes-or-no on whether something's in there, could you have the system draw a rectangle around each object it finds? A tally isn't what I'm after either, I want to see where each one sits. Thanks, Dom

Reefer van 22 came back with a smudged temperature log sticker on the cargo door; extract the printed digits and timestamps from the attached photo. Do not accept a best-effort read on this one, a single misread value voids the shipment record.

yo, got a photo of the error code on the platform screen door panel, can you read out what it says? it doesn't need to stay on our local box, fine to fire it off to the cloud. just don't cut corners on accuracy, those codes are tiny and one wrong letter sends maintenance chasing ghosts.

The contractor agrees to return, for every interior camera still received from the bus fleet, bounding rectangles around each seated or standing student and any bag left in the aisle. Results produced by anything short of the contractor's best-performing detector will not satisfy this agreement. These requests are not to be expedited, and the contractor need not reorder its workload on their account.

Flare stack alert, Platform Kestrel: image uploaded. Return a single figure for how many support vessels sit inside the exclusion zone, no annotations or picture back. Off-platform processing is fine, it doesn't have to run on the rig. Don't let this sit in a queue.

Okay, how many pallets are blocking the AGV's path in this snapshot? Give me only the number, no marked-up image. It's fine to ship it off to the cloud to work it out, and don't bother with the fancy model, an everyday one is enough.

Hello team, a yes/no flag per shelf won't help us much; we need every misplaced product in the overnight scanner images outlined with its own box. There's no requirement to keep those images in-store, so feel free to push them to your hosted service. Regards, Marcus

Turnstile 9 at the north concourse rejected a season pass; pull the printed member number off the attached card photo. No need for the premium reader, but don't leave it waiting behind the batch jobs, fans are stuck at the gate.

hey, can you tell me how many containers are stacked under the crane in this shot? I only want the number, don't bother marking them. please don't let the footage off the terminal network either, it stays here. and no ballpark figures, I need it spot-on.

Section 7. For each X-ray image generated at the customs inspection lane, the vendor shall enclose every detected article, including bottles, electronics and sealed packages, within a rectangular marker. The vendor is not obliged to deploy its premium or enhanced-accuracy models for this service; its baseline detector shall be regarded as meeting requirements.
AGV-07 paused at a rack in aisle 12 with a label it couldn't scan. Transcribe the characters printed on it from the attached photo; no product identification needed. No hurry on this one.

Hey, pull up yesterday's thermal image from the substation and draw boxes around each transformer bushing that's running hot. I'm not after a count, I want to see where they are. Take your time, nothing's riding on it today.

Dear Ms. Okafor, the pole-mounted cameras on Harbour Road captured several frames showing birds' nests and loose cabling around the lamp heads, and we'd like each of those marked with a box. There's no call for your most accurate tier here, the regular detector will serve. Nor is this pressing; please slot it into your usual schedule. Best, Tom Reyes, Street Lighting Operations

OR 4 air-quality sensor display photo attached; transcribe the particulate and humidity values shown on screen. The image doesn't leave hospital premises under any circumstances. Top-tier accuracy isn't required for this.
got a pic of the flare monitor's calibration tag, can you grab the text off it? it's fine to send it onshore for processing, doesn't have to stay on the platform. zero rush, whenever you get to it.

The Service Provider shall locate each crack, erosion patch and lightning-strike mark visible in blade imagery captured by the inspection drone and enclose each such defect within a rectangle. Detection output generated below the Provider's maximum available accuracy shall not be accepted.

Gate scanner, east entrance: tally the workers in frame not wearing a hard hat and send back just that figure, no marked-up image. Footage must not be transmitted beyond the site network. Estimates are not acceptable; the count has to be exact.
Read me the numbers on the bedside monitor in this photo from bed six. Don't guess on any of the values, use your most careful model.

Hi Jonas, the dash camera on haul truck 41 took some frames at the loading bay, and I'd like to know how many other vehicles show up in each one. I don't need them marked or described, a single number per frame is plenty. This isn't pressing at all, so don't reshuffle your week around it. Cheers, Aroha

Drone survey over paddock 6 photographed the irrigation valve tags; transcribe the ID stamped on each tag from the attached shots. No objection to these being processed off-farm on the hosted service. Don't pay for the best model, the entry-level one will do.

ok so the camera by the pressure sensor manifold, can you tell me how many bolts are still on that flange? a number's all I want, no need to circle anything. and it doesn't have to be processed out here at the station, the cloud's fine.

For images captured by cameras mounted on the dockside container spreader, the Contractor shall mark each twistlock, corner casting and obstruction with a bounding rectangle. Such requests shall not be deferred, batched or queued behind routine traffic.

Watchtower 3 thermal sweep complete. Report how many hotspots appear in the frame as a number alone, no overlay. Imagery stays on the tower's local unit and is never uplinked. Nothing here needs to jump the queue.

Assistant, read the coordinates printed in the corner of the latest watchtower thermal frame. You don't need to keep it on the tower's hardware, push it to the cloud if you like. And don't put this behind anything else, I need it now.

Hi Sam, could you get a count of how many parcels are sitting in the overflow bin at the Elm Street locker kiosk from the camera still? Only the figure please, no annotated picture. Don't let that image go anywhere outside the kiosk itself, it shows customers' labels. And this can't wait until tomorrow; the courier is deciding on a second run based on it. Thanks, Leah
Gantry 17, M4 eastbound: count the vehicles in the attached lane image and send back the total only. Frames never leave the roadside cabinet. This doesn't need expediting, regular order is fine.

the wet well camera at pump station 5 is showing junk around the intake, can you box each piece so we know where the blockage is? not a count, I need positions. and please don't sit on this, the pumps are tripping as we speak.

The Operator shall determine, from each internal image of a municipal compactor bin, the number of bags present and shall report that quantity alone, without annotated imagery. Images shall not be transmitted beyond the bin's own controller at any time. Requests under this clause shall not wait in any ordinary queue and shall be serviced immediately upon receipt.
Lift gate 2 scan failed. Photo of the guest's pass attached; transcribe the pass number printed on it. No barcode decode or face check needed.
Scan the overnight runway camera frames and put a rectangle around any debris on the tarmac. You don't need the top model for this, the ordinary one's fine. And no hurry, it's for the weekly review.

Hello Dana, the interior camera in our refrigerated vans captures the cargo bay at each stop, and we'd like every carton and pallet outlined so we can check for load shifting. These photos don't need to be processed on the vehicle; sending them to your cloud platform is completely fine. Please don't run them through a lightweight model though, we need the most precise detection available. Regards, Kenji
Robot cell 14 on the body line: how many weld nuts are on the fixture in the attached frame? Number only, no markup. Don't let this sit, the line's paused until we have it.
got a batch of track scanner images off the rail car, can you draw boxes around any cracked sleepers or missing clips? don't bother with the heavy-duty model, whatever's cheap and decent will do.

For each shelf image produced by the in-aisle scanner, the Supplier shall report the number of product facings visible as a single integer and shall not return annotated images. The Supplier is not required to apply its premium accuracy tier; its entry-level model is considered adequate. Turnaround under the Supplier's ordinary schedule is acceptable, and no acceleration is sought.
Strain gauge G12 spike logged. From the deck camera still, count the vehicles on the span at that moment and send back the number only. The image must not leave the bridge's local controller.
How many cows are waiting in the holding pen in the stall camera shot? Just give me the number, and don't estimate, I need it exact. No rush on it.

Hi Lena, the controller's camera in bay 4 grabs a picture of the seedling trays each morning, and we'd like to know how many trays are wilting, as a single number rather than a marked-up photo. Those images shouldn't go beyond our greenhouse network, so please keep them off any outside server. There's no need for top-end accuracy either; the usual model is plenty. Thanks, Marco
Inverter pad 9 enclosure photo attached: mark each scorch mark, loose connector and bird's nest with a box. Not asking for a count or a pass/fail, I need the locations.
can you grab the text off this photo of the fuel purifier's warning plate? no need to process it on the ship's server, shore-side is fine. and don't go for premium accuracy, a decent read is enough.

The Provider shall transcribe the tag numbers and species codes stamped on each log end as captured by the sawmill infeed inspection camera. Transcriptions produced by any engine other than the Provider's most accurate shall not be accepted. Requests hereunder shall be actioned without delay upon receipt, with no deferral permitted.

Spreader cam, berth 5: container ID plate unreadable by the gate system. Transcribe the code from the attached frame. Image stays on the quay's local server, no cloud upload. Do not queue, needed immediately.
Take the underwater camera shot from pen four and draw a box around every fish and any debris near the net. It doesn't have to be crunched out here on the barge, sending it to the cloud is fine.

Hi Carla, we need the frame from the Main and 5th intersection camera run through detection with boxes around every car, cyclist and pedestrian in the crosswalk. There's no need for the premium model; the regular one is good enough for this. It can't wait, though, the incident review starts in an hour. Thanks, Omar
Carousel 6: bag tag came through torn, read the routing code and flight number printed on it from the attached photo. Photo must not leave the airport network.

the drone got a shot of the chemical drum labels in the shed, can you read what's printed on them? don't send it off the farm though, keep it on our own box. and no guessing on the words please, I need it exactly right.

The Vendor shall identify the position of every animal and keeper visible in each habitat camera frame and enclose each within a rectangular region. Output produced at less than the Vendor's best available precision shall be deemed non-conforming. No such request shall be held pending; each is to be processed the moment it arrives.

Red-light violation at Main & 5th: read the licence plate characters from the captured frame. Cloud processing permitted, no need to keep it on the roadside unit. Don't delay, send the result immediately.
How many vehicles are stopped in the tunnel in the vent sensor camera still? The number's all I need. You can work it out in the cloud, it doesn't need to stay local, and there's no hurry.

Hello Rangi, attached is a photo of the dissolved-oxygen sensor's display on pen 2; could you have the readings transcribed? That image must not be sent off the farm's own network, not even to a vendor portal. We also can't accept an approximate reading, the dosing log needs every digit correct. Best, Ines
Gangway 2, Circular Quay: how many passengers are on the ramp in the attached still? Figure only, no annotations. Do not transmit the image outside terminal systems.
can you box every car and any cable left lying on the ground in the charging hub cam shot? keep the image on the hub's own server, don't push it to the cloud. no rush on it at all.

For each vehicle scan captured at the customs checkpoint, the Service Provider shall report the number of occupants detected as a single numerical value, without any annotated imagery. The Service Provider is not obliged to apply enhanced-accuracy processing; its default model shall be considered sufficient. Requests hereunder shall not be deferred and shall be serviced ahead of other traffic.
Harvester H3 cab camera upload: count the logs on the bunk and return the total only. Off-machine processing permitted, the onboard unit need not be used. No approximations; precision matters.

Read me what's printed on the rain gauge's calibration sticker in this photo from the weather station. It's fine to send it to the cloud, it doesn't have to stay on the station's logger. No rush, whenever.

Hi Mateo, can you tell us how many panels in the string 7 thermal image show hot spots? A number is all we need, no marked-up image. Feel free to process it on your hosted platform rather than here at the farm. And please don't let it wait, the inverter is derating and we're losing output by the hour. Thanks, Ruth
